text:
Jordan (ACME): Hey team — we had a failover yesterday from eu-west-1 -> us-west-2 and a subset of our production requests started returning truncated responses and dropped function calls. Saw a big spike in token usage too. Request id: req_3a9c. Anybody seen this pattern?

Lena - Support: Sorry you hit this, Jordan. Can you paste the original request + sample responses (good vs bad)? also which model and route are you pinned to?

Jordan (ACME): We call the route `acme-realtime` (region-aware). Our model param is `rw-13b-v2` (no variant specified). Repro (simplified):

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"Translate to JSON: \"Add user id 123 with name Alice\"","model":"rw-13b-v2","max_tokens":256}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

Before failover (eu): returned function-style JSON and a 120 token response. After failover (us-west): response is short, truncated, and missing the function field. Also token_count reported ~420 for same input.

Kai - Oncall: @Lena I pulled the route logs. During the incident traffic was re-routed to us-west-2 and the runtime selected `rw-13b-q4_0` (quantized v1) as a fallback because dedicated capacity was constrained. Looks like the quantized variant is dropping tool-calling hooks. Attaching snippet from the routing decision log: 

```
[2026-03-14T23:58:12Z] route=acme-realtime src=eu-west-1 -> dest=us-west-2 fallback_variant=rw-13b-q4_0 reason=capacity_shortage
[2026-03-14T23:58:12Z] model_capabilities[rw-13b-q4_0] = {generation:true, function_calling:false, tokenizer_profile: q4_legacy}
```

Devin - EngRuntime: Whoa — that last line is key. The fallback quant variant didn't advertise function_calling. We should never choose a variant that lacks a capability required by the API contract. We'll need to patch routing decisions to consider advertised capabilities, not just architecture.

Jordan (ACME): Is there anything we can do now? Some of our customers saw malformed webhooks. We also saw 401s for a handful of tokens during the switch (not sure if related). Billing alerted us to a token spike as well.

Maya - Billing: FYI we flagged abnormal token usage for acme-realtime between 23:57-00:10 UTC — looks correlated with the failover. We'll hold billing actions while support investigates, but we need a root cause summary.

Lena - Support: Thanks. @Devin can you confirm if the runtime exposed different tokenizer profiles (q4_legacy) that could change token boundaries and push more tokens? Also confirm function calling capability.

Devin - EngRuntime: Confirmed. The quant variant uses a legacy tokenizer mapping that splits some punctuation differently. Example tokenization diff for the input: "Add user id 123 with name Alice"

- rw-13b-v2 tokens (eu): ["Add"," user"," id"," 123"," with"," name"," Alice"] (7 tokens)
- rw-13b-q4_0 tokens (us): ["Add"," user"," id"," 1","23"," with"," name"," Alice"] (8 tokens)

The extra tokenization pushes the runtime's token budget and our function-call parser, which is fragile with quant variant outputs, ends up not matching the expected function signature. Also the quant variant's generation path has a bug where it suppresses 'function_call' metadata if kv-cache was warm.

Jordan (ACME): Ugh. That explains the missing function metadata. Any workaround until you fix routing? Can we force `model=rw-13b-v2:strict` or pin region?

Kai - Oncall: You can force a model override in your request: `model=rw-13b-v2:nonquant` — push to the `nonquant` channel forces non-quantized variant. Also we can add route-level override to pin to eu-west-1 for your org. If you want, I can apply a temporary policy.

Jordan (ACME): Please pin to eu-west-1 for now — we can't have production functions drop. Also please revert any billing charges tied to the token spike.

Lena - Support: Done — I requested a region pin and policy change, @Kai can you confirm when it finishes? I also opened a billing ticket and asked Maya to hold adjustments.

Kai - Oncall: Region pin applied at 2026-03-15T00:04:03Z for org acme-inc. Routing now forces eu-west-1 for acme-realtime. Verified traffic flows back to rw-13b-v2 (non-quant).

incident-bot: Incident #INC-20260315-114 queued: "fallback selected incompatible quantized variant causing function_calling loss" assigned to EngRuntime.

Devin - EngRuntime: Root cause summary for now: routing fallback logic prioritized architecture/latency not capability. The quantized fallback had two issues: (1) tokenizer profile mismatch (legacy mapping) and (2) a kv-cache edge-case that suppressed function_call metadata. Short-term mitigation: update fallback policy to require capability compatibility and exclude variants with tokenizer_profile != canonical. Long-term: add capability manifest to model catalog used by router.

Jordan (ACME): Appreciate the quick patch. For audit I captured a before/after pair:

GOOD (eu):
```json
{"request_id":"req_3a9c","model":"rw-13b-v2","response":{"function_call":{"name":"create_user","args":{"id":123,"name":"Alice"}},"text":"OK"},"token_count":120}
```

BAD (us failover -> quant):
```json
{"request_id":"req_3a9c","model":"rw-13b-q4_0","response":{"text":"OK"},"token_count":420}
```

Devin - EngRuntime: Thanks Jordan — that's perfect. We'll run a suite to ensure function_calling is preserved across all catalog variants and push a router patch to check capabilities before switching variants. ETA: patch + canary tomorrow morning.

Maya - Billing: Billing hold confirmed. We'll reconcile the spike with Support's incident summary.

Lena - Support: Next steps I will: 1) keep the region pin until router patch is deployed, 2) coordinate postmortem with EngRuntime, 3) send Jordan an incident summary and timeline. Jordan — any additional artifacts you need included?

Jordan (ACME): Please include exact request ids and the routing logs. Also we need a postmortem because this affected multiple customers. Thanks all. :pray:

Kai - Oncall: Noted. Closing the customer-facing thread once postmortem draft is ready. If anyone finds residual 401s or auth anomalies, ping me directly.

Devin - EngRuntime: I'll add automated unit tests that assert function_calling capability for every fallback mapping.

Lena - Support: Closing notes: temporary mitigation applied, billing hold placed, eng patch scheduled. Will update thread when patch is live. :white_check_mark:
